killswitch.confirm.all: Every running flow will be signalled to stop and its sandbox shut down. This cannot be undone: reopening does not resurrect the stopped runs.

killswitch.note.admin_only: The kill switch requires the admin role.
killswitch.note.delegated: This session is held by an AI tool on your behalf. The kill switch is a human-only channel (M101); the MCP surface can only raise a proposal.
killswitch.resume.desc: New work is accepted again. Stopped runs do not come back.

mcp.note.no_gate_decision: MCP lists gates, summarises them and reminds their owner — but it cannot decide one. An approval signature comes only from a human channel; otherwise "producer ≠ approver" (M32) would exist on paper only.
